support_story_1_headline: Musi vhabveledzi vha tshi bvela phanḓa, tshitshavha tshi a ḓiimisela.
support_story_1_lead: U tsireledza tshishumiswa tshavho kha zwikwekwe zwa hardware yo fhumulaho na mvusuludzo dzo tshinyalaho.
support_story_1_body: Innioasis i dzulela u bvisa dzi-firmware ntswa dza vhatambi vha ngaho Y1 (dzi tshi khou sedza kha mvusuludzo dza bodo dzo dzumbamaho dzi ngaho 6.0, 7.0, na 8.0) dzine dza fhaladza zwishumiswa zwa kale nga u fhumula. Zwivhisaho, webusaithi yavho i ṋea ngeletshedzo dza zero na tswikelelo ya zero kha dzi-firmware dzo fhiraho dzi shumaho u itela u vusuludzwa kha tshiimo tsho fhaṱiwaho nga zwidina. Updater CE na phurojeke ya Community Firmware vha dzhia zwipiḓa: ri vhulunga ROM iṅwe na iṅwe ya tshitoko tsha kale, ri khwaṱhisedza nga vhuḓiitisi mvusuludzo yaṋu ya hardware, na u ita uri mutambi waṋu a dzule a tshi khou shuma nga nḓila yo tsireledzeaho.
support_story_1_item_1: U Phulusa Vhatambi vho Tshinyalaho: U ṱola tsireledzo zwi khwaṱhisedza uri mvelaphanḓa ntswa a dzi vhuyi dza tshinya hardware ya kale.
support_story_1_item_2: ROM dza Stock dzo vhulungwaho: U kuvhanganya ho fhelelaho ha dzi-firmware dza fekhiṱiri dza u thoma Innioasis yo phumulwa.
support_story_1_item_3: Puḽatifomo ya Mvelele: Zwishumiswa zwo fhelelaho zwa u penya zwa macOS, Linux, na Windows nga u fana.
support_story_1_item_4: Vhuṱali ha Hardware: U ḓivha bodo nga vhuḓiitisi uri u dzule u tshi wana phasela yo teaho.
support_story_2_headline: Ahuna Google Drive dzo tshinyalaho. Ahuna mushumo wa u humbulela. Firmware i khou shuma fhedzi.
support_story_2_lead: Themamveledziso ya tshitshavha ya luvhilo lwa nṱha, yo khwaṱhisedzwaho ine na nga ḓitika ngayo zwa vhukuma.
support_story_2_body: U tevhela sofuthiwee ya Innioasis ya tshiofisi kanzhi zwi amba u ṱola foramu dza vhuṱumani ha Google Drive ho fhelelwaho nga tshifhinga, mikovhe ya gole ḽa Baidu yo faho, na faila dza zip dza tshiphiri dzi si na zwishumiswa zwi penyaho. Ro fhaṱa nethiweke ya u dawuniḽouda i fulufhedzeaho, yo ḓiimisaho nga yoṱhe i re na vhuḓifulufheli ho khwaṱhisedzwaho ha SHA-256, nḓivhadzo dza u khwinisa, na u dzhenisa ho livhiswaho nga vhukando nga vhukando. Miṋeelo yaṋu i vhulunga nga ho livhaho zwithu zwo ṱalutshedzelwaho na u ṱanganedza zwine zwa ita uri zwenezwi zwi konadzee awara dza 24 nga ḓuvha, maḓuvha a 365 nga ṅwaha.
support_story_2_item_1: Direct High-Speed ​​CDN: U dawuniḽouda hu ṱavhanyaho, ho livhaho hu si na mikano ya u dawuniḽouda kana vhuṱumani ho faho.
support_story_2_item_2: Nḓivhadzo dza u khwinisa: Kha vha tsivhudzwe nga tshifhinga tshine tshitshavha tshiswa tsha bvisa kana khwiniso dza wela fhasi.
support_story_2_item_3: U Dzhenisa ho Livhiswaho nga Vhukando nga Vhukando: Zwiṱuṱuwedzi zwi vhonalaho zwi vhonalaho zwi ni livhisa kha u tsitsa buthano ḽiṅwe na ḽiṅwe.
support_story_2_item_4: Tshitshavha tsha Nyambo Nnzhi: Zwo ṱanganedzwa nga vhuḓalo nga Luisimane, Lutshaina, Ludzheremane, Lupania, Lufura & Ludzhapani.
support_story_3_headline: U vula khonadzeo dzo fhelelaho dza mutambi waṋu wa Innioasis.
support_story_3_lead: U ḓisa Rockbox, sisiṱeme dza u shuma dzi leluwaho dzo ḓoweleaho, na mbofholowo ya vhathetshelesi.
support_story_3_body: Sofuthiwee ya fekhiṱiri ya zwitoko i tou ṱomola fhedzi zwine hardware yaṋu ya Y1 kana Y2 ya nga zwi ita. Tshitshavha tshashu tsho ḓisa Rockbox, sisiṱeme dza u shuma dzo khetheaho dzi leluwaho, u tamba ha codec ya audiophile, na thero dzo khetheaho kha vhutshilo. Ri renga tshanduko dza hardware ya muvhili nga nnḓa ha tshikwama u itela u linga, u vhuedzedza murahu, na u khwaṱhisedza u dzheniswa huṅwe na huṅwe. U tikedza Updater CE zwi ṋetshedza masheleni thwii kha yuniti idzi dza ndingo na u ṱavhanyedza mveledziso ya firmware yo khetheaho.
support_story_3_item_1: Rockbox ya u tou ṋanga luthihi: U tamba ha Audiophile na thero dzo khetheaho dzo dzheniswaho nga mithethe.
support_story_3_item_2: Firmware ya Tshitshavha: U khwiniswa ha beṱiri, UI yo kunaho, na thikhedzo ya codec ya oḓio ya musalauno.
support_story_3_item_3: Active Hardware Lab: Ri linga kha zwishumiswa zwa vhukuma zwa muvhili ri sa athu bvisa fhaṱo naho i ifhio.
support_story_3_item_4: Zero Bloatware: 100% ya mahala, sofuthiwee ya u thoma ya tshiphiri i si na khungedzelo kana u tevhela.
support_story_4_headline: Ri thuseni u ita zwine Innioasis ya sa zwi ite.
support_story_4_lead: U vhulunga firmware yo ṋetshedzwaho maanḓa nga tshitshavha zwi tshi ita uri zwishumiswa zwavho zwi si vhe maḓakani.
support_story_4_body: Musi khamphani ya hardware i tshi fhira kha tshishumiswa tshayo tshi tevhelaho, modele dza kale dzi a ṱutshelwa. Innioasis a i ṋetshedzi thikhedzo ya Linux, a i na dzi-changelog dzi re khagala, nahone a i na nḓila yo leluwaho ya u vhuisa musi u dzhenisa hu tshi kundelwa. Updater CE i hone ngauri vhashumisi vha re na lufuno a vho ngo fanela u laṱa tshitambiswa tsha muzika tshavhuḓi tsho fhelelaho. 100% ya miṋeelo ya tshitshavha i ya thwii kha u vhulunga tshishumiswa itshi tsho vulea kha muṅwe na muṅwe.
support_story_4_item_1: Rescue & Unbrick: U vusuludzwa ho khwaṱhisedzwaho hu a elela naho zwishumiswa zwi tshi hana u thoma.
support_story_4_item_2: Thikhedzo ya Linux ya Kiḽasi ya u Thoma: MediaTek yo tikedzwaho nga vhuḓalo i penyaho kha dzi-distros dza Linux.
support_story_4_item_3: Transparent Changelogs: Notsi dza u bvisa dzo ṱanḓavhuwaho u itela uri ni ḓivhe zwavhuḓi uri ndi tshanduko dzifhio.
support_story_4_item_4: 100% Community Funded: Khofhe inwe na inwe i ita uri archive i dzule yo vulea nahone ndi mahala kha vhothe.

install_power_on_steps_fmt: U itela u vula {label} yaṋu, bvisani USB nahone ni fare {button}.
install_disconnect_guidance_fmt:
Musi vha sa athu isa phanḓa, kha vha:

1. Arali i sa athu dzima, dzimani muḓagasi wa {label} yaṋu .
   (Ni nga shumisa pini kana paperclip u itela u tsitsa buthano ḽa u vhuyedzedza arali zwi tshi ṱoḓea)

Nga murahu ni dzhene kha OK nahone ni tevhele ndaela dzi re kha tshikirini.
rockbox_y1_theme_warning_prompt: Rockbox on Y1 no longer supports iPod classic (240p) themes from Rockbox.org - you'll have to use 360p Rockbox themes made for Y1 - click next to continue
sp_gui_prompt_steps_fmt:
• Arali i sa athu dzima, dzimani {label} yaṋu.
• Arali yo ṱangana na USB, thomani nga u i bvisa.
• Kha Tshishumiswa tsha SP Flash, kha vha puṱedze Download.

Nga murahu ha zwenezwo, ṱanganya thambo ya USB uri i thome u penya.
sel_type_help_body:

sel_install_tooltip_generic: Kha vha panga sofuthiwee ya sisiṱeme yo khethiwaho kha tshishumiswa tshavho
dl_resuming_fmt: U thoma hafhu u dawuniḽouda u bva kha {mb} MB...
dl_retry_fmt: Vhuṱumani ho thithisea. Ndi khou lingedza hafhu ({attempt}/{max})...
linux_engine_ready_msg: Injini ya u penya yo lugela.
linux_engine_staged_desc: Tshishumiswa tsha Flash tsha MediaTek SP tsho ṱanganywaho na u tendelana ha libpng12.
linux_engine_recheck_desc: Kha vha puṱedze Re-check kana vha thome hafhu u dzudzanya u itela u dawuniḽouda phakhethe.
linux_usb_rules_active_desc: Milayo ya MediaTek i khou shuma (/na zwiṅwe-vho/udev/milayo.d/). Tswikelelo ya desktop yo tendelwa.
linux_usb_grant_desc: Ṋeani thendelo luthihi uri app i kone u davhidzana na tshishumiswa tshaṋu.
linux_perms_ok_msg: Thendelo dza USB & milayo ya udev zwo dzheniswa zwavhuḓi. Tshumelo dzo dzudzanywa.
donate_rely_on_you: Ri thuseni nga zwithu zwashu zwa u tshimbidza, donate namusi.
flash_sp_gui_tooltip: Vula GUI ya Tshishumiswa tsha Fuḽeshe tsha MediaTek SP
status_app_reset_defaults: App yo vusuludzwa tshoṱhe kha mvelele, cache ya u dawuniḽouda yo phumulwa, na khumbudzo ya beṱiri yo vhuyedzedzwa.
log_app_reset_defaults: Nzudzanyo ya app yo vhuedzedzwa tshoṱhe kha mvelele, cache ya u dawuniḽouda yo bviswa, na khumbudzo ya beṱiri yo vhuyedzedzwa (R).
flash_watch_waiting: Ndi khou lindela player yavho i tshi thoma hafhu...
flash_watch_waiting_hint: Kha vha dzule vho i plug in, Rockbox i khou thoma u shuma na theme dzayo dzi do engedzwa nga dzone dzine.
flash_watch_found: Mutambi o wanala, u engedza thero dza Rockbox...
flash_watch_timeout_hint: Sedzani uri yo dzheniswa kha pulaga nahone yo vulea. Arali zwa dzula zwo swifhala, ṋaṋisani pini kha hole ya u vusuludza nahone ni fare buthano ḽa vhukati (Y1) kana buthano ḽa maanḓa (vhaṅwe vhatambi) u itela u i thoma hafhu. Arali i tshi kha ḓi ḓo thoma, firmware a yo ngo dzhia, dzhenisa iṅwe.
action_searching: Ndi khou toda tshishumiswa (dzulani tsho bviswa kha pulaga)...
action_brom_detected: Tshishumiswa tsho wanala kha moudu wa BROM...
action_flash_complete: Flash yo fhelela! Kha vha bvise USB vha thome hafhu.
task_writing_system: U ṅwala sofuthiwee ya sisiṱeme khulwane
task_writing_boot: Sisiṱeme ya u thoma ya u ṅwala
task_writing_recovery: U ṅwala sofuthiwee ya u vhuisa
task_writing_logo: Logo ya u sumbedza u ṅwala
task_writing_user_storage: U ṅwala khethekanyo ya mbulungelo ya mushumisi
task_writing_partition_table: U ṅwala nzudzanyo ya khethekanyo ya tshishumiswa
task_writing_partition_generic: Tshipiḓa tsha firmware ya tshishumiswa tsha u ṅwala
action_recover_powercycle: Power-cycle player (u fara maanḓa ~10s), u kone u i ṱumanya hafhu - u lingedza hafhu...
action_wait_mtk: U lindela tshishumiswa tsha MTK... Dzima tshishumiswa tsha maanḓa na u ṱanganya USB.
action_da_stall: Tshishumiswa tsho ima u fhindula musi tshi tshi khou dzudzanya zhendedzi ḽa u dawuniḽouda. I dzimeni tshoṱhe, ni dovhe ni i ṱume, nahone ni lingedze hafhu.
action_detected_brom: Tshishumiswa tsho tumbulwa (moudu wa BROM) - u dzudzanya zhendedzi ḽa u dawuniḽouda...
action_detected_preloader: Tshishumiswa tsho tumbulwa (moudu wa u thoma u ḓadza) - u dzudzanya zhendedzi ḽa u dawuniḽouda...
action_da_wait_back: Mutambi o mbo ḓi litsha u fhindula musi a tshi khou thoma tshishumiswa tsha u ṱalutshedzela. Ndi khou lindela uri i vhuye...
action_device_connected: Tshishumiswa tsho ṱumanaho - u lugisela ndaela dza u ṅwala...
action_install_in_progress: U dzhenisa zwi khou bvela phanḓa
action_formatting: U fometha data ya mushumisi na cache...
action_restart_brom: U thoma hafhu mutambi kha moudu wa BROM...
log_install_writing: U panga hu khou bvela phanḓa - u ṅwala zwifanyiso zwa firmware...
log_sparse_fmt: Tshifanyiso tsho wanalaho tsha Android tsha {part}, tshi khou shandukisa kha maitele...
err_code_connection_failed: A thi koni u ṱumana na tshishumiswa
err_code_mtk_import_failed: MTKClient a yo ngo kona u ḓadzwa
err_code_sp_not_found: Tshishumiswa tsha SP Flash a tsho ngo wanala
err_code_no_scatter: Ahuna faela ya u phaḓalala kha phasela
err_code_missing_images: Zwifanyiso zwa firmware zwi khou xela kha phasela
err_code_partition_table_invalid: U khwaṱhisedzwa ha thebulu ya khethekanyo zwo kundelwa nga murahu ha u ṅwala
err_sp_wrong_model: U ṱanganya modele wo khakheaho wa mutambi. Kha vha puṱedze × u itela u khansela u dzhenisa uhu, nga murahu vha khethe sofuthiwee ya player ye vha i ṱumanya.
err_sp_timeout: Tshishumiswa a tsho ngo vhuya tsha vhona mutambi. I dzule yo dzima na u i bvisa kha pulaga, nga murahu ni ṱume thambo ya USB musi no humbelwa.
err_sp_brom_startcmd: Mutambi o mbo di power up hu tshe na tshifhinga. I dzimeni tshoṱhe, ni kone u dovha na i ṱumanya.
err_sp_download_fail: U ṅwala zwo vha zwo thithisea. Sedzani thambo ya USB na port na charge ya beṱiri, ni lingedze hafhu.
err_sp_da_init_sync: Muimeleli wa u dawuniḽouda ha koni u thoma. Lingedzani iṅwe nḓila ya flash.
err_sp_brom_da_fail: Muimeleli wa u ṱalutshedzela a nga si kone u rumelwa kha mutambi. I dzimeni power ni dovhe ni i ṱume.
err_sp_da_invalid_type: Mutambi o hana muimeleli wa u ṱalutshedzela (vhukhakhi 6104). Shumisani Muimeleli wa u Download o ṱanganyiswaho na Tshishumiswa tsha SP Flash, nahone ni sedze arali firmware i tshimbilelana na tshenetshi tshitambiswa.
err_sp_com_port: Tshishumiswa tsho vha tshi sa koni u vula port yatsho ya serial. Vhalani zwiṅwe zwishumiswa zwi penyaho nahone ni dovhe ni zwi ṱume.
err_com_port_reboot_suggestion: Vhuimazwikepe ha USB COM a vhu koni u vulea (vhukhakhi ha 1013). U thoma hafhu khomphyutha yaṋu zwi ḓo bvisa port yo khiiwaho. Kha vha thome hafhu khomphyutha yavho vha lingedze hafhu.
err_sp_enable_dram: Tshishumiswa tsho vha tshi sa koni u thoma memori ya mutambi. Shumisani phakhethe yo fhaṱelwaho modele uyu wo teaho.
err_sp_storage_read: Tshishumiswa tsho vha tshi sa koni u vhala vhudzulo ha mutambi. Sedzani vhuṱumani; tshishumiswa tshi nga vha na vhukhakhi ha hardware.
err_attempt_timeout: Tshishumiswa tsha u penya tsho sumbedza uri a hu na mvelaphanḓa hu sa athu fhela mithethe ya {seconds}, ngauralo ndingedzo iyi yo mbo ḓi imiswa.
err_connection_failed_desc: A ri koni u thoma vhushaka ho dzikaho na mutambi. Vhonani uri tshishumiswa tsho dzimiwa (shumisani pini u itela u tsitsa buthano ḽa u vusuludza arali zwi tshi ṱoḓea), bvisani USB, nahone ni dovhe ni ṱanganedze musi no humbelwa.
err_flash_write_failed_desc: U penya ho vha ho thithiswa kana mushumo wa u ṅwala wo kundelwa. Sedzani uri thambo ya USB yo ṱangana zwavhuḓi na uri beṱiri i na charge yo eḓanaho, nga murahu ni lingedze hafhu.
err_mtk_output_stall_title: Flash i vhonala i tshi khou khwatha .
err_mtk_output_stall_desc: Tshishumiswa tsha u penya tsho sumbedza mutevhe muthihi lwa mithethe ya {seconds} yo fhiraho nahone a tshi vhonali tshi tshi khou bvela phanḓa na u ṅwala firmware. Flash i nga vha yo kundelwa. Arali hezwi zwo vha zwi zwa u fhedzisela kha u lingedza huvhili na nḓila iṅwe na iṅwe kha sisiṱeme ine ya nga wela murahu vhukati hazwo, kana arali hu MTKClient fhedzi ine ya vha hone kha mutshini uyu, thomani khomphyutha hafhu nahone ni lingedze hafhu.
err_only_mtkclient_title: Ndi MTKClient fhedzi ine ya vha hone
err_only_mtkclient_desc: Ndi MTKClient fhedzi ine ya vha hone kha u dzhenisa uhu. Flash i nga vha yo kundelwa. Kha vha thome hafhu khomphyutha vha lingedze hafhu.
err_mtk_output_stall_fallback_available: Khomphyutha iyi i nga dovha ya dzheniswa hu tshi shumiswa SP Flash Tool. Arali ni tshi nga kona, shandukelani kha SP Flash Tool nahone ni lingedze hafhu.
prompt_restart_and_quit_title: Kha vha thome hafhu khomphyutha yavho
prompt_restart_and_quit_desc: Flash i nga vha yo kundelwa. Kha vha vhale mulaedza u re afho nṱha vha vusuludze khomphyutha vha sa athu lingedza hafhu. Arali na puṱedza OK, app i ḓo litsha u itela uri ni kone u thoma hafhu.
err_missing_package_files_title: Phakhethe ya Firmware i sa shumi
err_missing_package_files_desc: Phakhethe ya firmware i khou ṱahela faila ya u phaḓalala kana faila dza zwifanyiso dzi ṱoḓeaho. Kha vha dawuniḽoude hafhu phakhethe kana vha khethe faila ya firmware yo fhelelaho.
err_auth_file_unusable_title: Faela ya u khwaṱhisedza a i shumi
err_auth_file_unusable_desc: Faela ya khwaṱhisedzo ye na i nanga a iho, a i na tshithu kana a i nga ṅwalwi. Khethani faela i shumaho, kana ni i bvise kha Settings, nahone ni dovhe ni flash.
err_tool_unavailable_title: Tshishumiswa tsha u penya a tshi wanali
err_tool_unavailable_desc: Tshishumiswa tshi penyaho kana vhareili vha sisiṱeme vha ṱoḓeaho a vho ngo kona u thomiwa. Kha vha sedze thendelo dza sisiṱeme, nzudzanyo ya mureili, kana vha panga hafhu tshumiso.
err_driver_missing_title: Hu khou todea mutshimbidzi wa USB wa MediaTek
err_driver_missing_desc: Vhukhakhi uhu vhu nga itea musi tshiendedzi tsha USB tsha MediaTek tshi songo dzheniswa. Kha vha puṱedze Download Drivers u itela u dzhenisa tshiendedzi tsha USB tsha MediaTek, vha thome hafhu khomphyutha yavho, nahone vha lingedze hafhu.
err_cache_file_missing_desc: Faela ya firmware yo vhulungwaho a iho. Khethani Khethani Sofuthiwee u itela u fhaṱa hafhu faila dzo bviswaho kana u dawuniḽouda hafhu akhaivi ya firmware. Heyi ndi thaidzo ya faela yapo, hu si thaidzo ya vhuṱumani ha USB.
sel_cache_retry_tooltip: Vhuyelelani kha Khethani Sofuthiwee u itela u fhaṱa hafhu kana u dawuniḽouda phakhethe ya firmware.
sel_cache_retry_select_release: Khethani mveledziso ya firmware u itela u i ṱalutshedzela hafhu.
err_generic_flash_failed_desc: Ho itea vhukhakhi vhu songo lavhelelwaho musi hu tshi khou dzheniswa ({detail}). Dzimani mutambi tshoṱhe, ni ṱume hafhu musi ni tshi humbelwa, nahone ni lingedze hafhu.
flash_method_confirm: Nḓila ya u dzhenisa yo shandukiswa ya vha {method}. Ṱhogomelani uri player yo bviswa kha pulaga nahone yo dzimiwa, nga murahu ni puṱedze Next.
flash_failover_note: {method} a yo ngo thoma u dzhenisa. Nga murahu ha musi mutambi o dzimiwa na u bviswa kha pulaga, hu ḓo shumiswa {other} nṱhani hazwo.
themepack_card_title: Kha vha panga Phakhethe ya Thero ya Rockbox ya 360p
themepack_card_desc: I katela thero dza tshitshavha dzo nakaho, zwifanyiso zwa murahu zwa resolution ya nṱha, na fonto dzo itwaho nga ho khetheaho u itela u sumbedza 360p.
themepack_install_btn: Kha vha wane Phakhethe ya Thero ya 360p
themepack_step1_title: Ḽiga 1: Ṱanganedzani kha Mode wa Vhudzulo ha USB
themepack_step1_desc:
1. Kha vha vule player yavho nga u fara button ya Power.
2. Musi Rockbox i tshi thoma u shuma, dzhenisani thambo ya USB kha khomphyutha yaṋu.
3. Arali na humbelwa kha tshikirini tsha mutambi, khwaṱhisedzani moudu wa USB Storage u itela uri tshishumiswa tshi vhonale sa drive.
themepack_step2_title: Vhukando 2: Khethani Folder Iṅwe na Iṅwe kha Player .
themepack_step2_desc: Nga ṅwambo wa uri sisiṱeme dza u shuma (u fana na macOS) dzi dzumba dotfiles (u fana na .rockbox) nga nḓila yo ḓoweleaho, ni nga khetha foldara IṄWE na iṅwe kana mudzi wa drive kha player yaṋu. Ri ḓo ni wana kana u ni itela ḓiresi ya .rockbox nga vhuḓiitisi.
themepack_status_downloading: U dawuniḽouda Phakhethe ya Thero ya 360p...
themepack_complete: Theme pack yo dzheniswa nga nḓila yo bvelelaho! Zwino ni nga bvisa tshitambiswa tshaṋu nga nḓila yo tsireledzeaho nahone na nanga thero kha Rockbox (Zwishumiswa > Zwishumiswa zwa Thero).
themepack_err_not_found: A zwi koni u wana kana u thoma ḓiresi ya .rockbox kha ḓiraivi yo khethiwaho. Kha vha khwaṱhisedze uri vho nanga foldara kha player yavho.
rockbox_wizard_title: Rockbox 360p Thero na Fonte dza u dzudzanya
rockbox_wizard_skip_adb: Kha vha ye kha Moudu wa Vhudzulo ha USB
rockbox_wizard_reboot_title: Ḽiga 1: Thomani hafhu mutambi nahone ni ṱanganedze hafhu
rockbox_wizard_reboot_desc:
1. Kha vha bvise thambo ya USB.
2. Power player i vhuyelele khayo ni i litshe i boot kha Rockbox.
3. Musi Rockbox i tshi khou shuma, dovhani ni ṱume thambo ya USB, ni kone u ṋaṋisa Continue.
rockbox_wizard_adb_title: Step 2: U ṱoḓa mutambi nga nṱha ha ADB...
rockbox_wizard_adb_desc: App i khou lavhelesa vhuṱumani ha ADB (u swika kha mithethe ya 30). Arali tshishumiswa tsha wanala, thero dzi a fhiriselwa kha vhaṅwe nahone mutambi a thoma hafhu nga vhuḓiitisi. Arali zwi songo ralo, ṱuwani phanḓa na Mode wa Vhuṱanzi wa USB.

1. Kha vha vule USB Storage Mode kha player uri i vhonale sa drive.
2. Khethani foldara IṄWE NA IṄWE kha mutambi a re afho fhasi (.rockbox, Muzika, Thero, kana mudzi wa drive, foldara yo dzumbamaho ya .rockbox i wanala nga yoṱhe).
